description: This file defines the GridLayout class for the Kivy framework, including properties, layout logic, and exception handling for arranging widgets in a grid.

classes.name: GridLayout
classes.description: A layout class that arranges child widgets in a grid with configurable rows, columns, spacing, and orientation.

classes.name: GridLayoutException
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors related to grid layout manipulation.

methods.name: nmax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value among the provided arguments, ignoring None.

methods.name: nmin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value among the provided arguments, ignoring None.

methods.name: GridLayout._init_rows_cols_sizes
methods.description: Initializes the sizes of rows and columns based on children count and layout constraints.

methods.name: GridLayout._fill_rows_cols_sizes
methods.description: Calculates minimum sizes for rows and columns considering size hints and constraints.

methods.name: GridLayout._update_minimum_size
methods.description: Computes the minimum size needed to contain all children, considering padding and spacing.

methods.name: GridLayout._finalize_rows_cols_sizes
methods.description: Finalizes the sizes of rows and columns, applying stretch and default size rules.

methods.name: GridLayout._iterate_layout
methods.description: Generates layout positions and sizes for each child based on orientation and fill direction.

methods.name: GridLayout.do_layout
methods.description: Performs the layout of child widgets, assigning positions and sizes.

methods.name: GridLayout._create_idx_iter
methods.description: Creates an iterator over grid indices based on fill direction and orientation.
